description: Gift ideas: use for any request for a gift or present idea. Suggest store gifts from Befana’s verified stores, by what the person likes, the occasion and a price range. With person_id (from people) it leaves out what the sender already gave them and fits the suggestions to that person. A recipient can pass swap_for with one of their gift ids to see what they could swap it for. Works signed out.

person_id.description: From people: suggestions fit to this person

query.description: What they like or what to look for, e.g. "tea", "candle", "running"

swap_for.description: Recipient only: a gift id from my_gifts

name: find_gifts
title: Find gifts
